text:
Morgan: quick sync — starting a small sprint to exercise temporary-privilege gating for base-image rebuilds and KMS signing. goal: ensure canary images are signed by a transient signer, RBAC changes are minimal, and all signing + push operations are captured in our audit logs.
Alejandra: ok — timeline? are we touching prod service-accounts or rolling new ephemeral ones?
Morgan: roll new ephemeral signer SA and a short-lived key. no prod SA changes. plan: cosign signing via cosign + KMS, signer SA granted only cryptoSigner and logWriter, attestation recorded in sbom bucket. 1st canary tomorrow AM.
Sam: how does audit-log retention look? some customers require longer retention — do we need a separate sink for signed-image events?
Jules: enable Data Access logs for Cloud KMS and Storage for the signer SA. create a restricted sink to the audit project with 2y retention for compliance customers; default team retention stays 90 days. also audit the signer SA's key access pattern.
Alejandra: role list proposal for ephemeral signer: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoSigner`, `roles/logging.logWriter` and a limited `roles/storage.objectCreator` for the canary bucket only. lmk if anything missing.
Morgan: looks right. also add a log entry tag for `image:rebuild` and `phase:canary` so we can filter easily.
Sam: can you paste the IAM commands so I can create the SA and bind roles in infra repo? I can also add a test that denies broad access.
Alejandra: sure — snippet I used in staging:
```
# create SA
gcloud iam service-accounts create ephemeral-cosign-signer \
  --display-name="ephemeral cosign signer"
# bind roles
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-infra \
  --member="serviceAccount:ephemeral-cosign-signer@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoSigner"
# limited storage writer
gsutil iam ch serviceAccount:ephemeral-cosign-signer@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com:objectCreator gs://image-canary-bucket
```
Morgan: perfect. for cosign we'll do ephemeral key access via `gcloud kms keys versions use` and short-lived token. example cosign command:
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood-infra/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKey/signer --output-signature=./sig.sig gcr.io/redwood/base:canary
```
Jules: reminder: enable audit logs for `GetCryptoKeyVersion` and `AsymmetricSign` and ensure sinks capture them. Also add an alert in ops when signer SA gets >3 sign calls/minute from unexpected IP ranges. :rotating_light:
Sam: deploy-bot: new canary deploy scheduled for 08:30 UTC tomorrow — any blockers?
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary image push -> integration tests -> canary rollout. Notified: #eng-runtime, #eng-sre.
Morgan: blockers: quick permission review and the sink. Alejandra — ping when SA created and key rotation policy set. Jules — please confirm the alert DSL and retention config.
Alejandra: will create SA + key and open PR with IAM bindings by EOD. adding service-account doc and least-priv notes.
Jules: I'll update the runbook with audit-sink steps and add the alert rule. also will add a short postmortem template for if canary rollback triggers.
Sam: I'll wire the sink and verify logs show `image:rebuild` tags in staging. will also add an automated smoke test that validates cosign signature verification against the public key.
Morgan: cool — last thing: vuln triage note — CVE reported for glibc in the current base image. image-qa already flagged it (low exploitability), but we'll include the rebuild in this window and mark the canary as high-priority. assign triage to security and eng-runtime.
Alejandra: added label `security:high` on the PR and linked the QA report.
Jules: noted. post-canary, we'll keep signed artifacts in immutable storage for forensics (30d hot, archive thereafter).
Morgan: action list: Alejandra create SA + PR; Sam create sink + verify tags; Jules update runbook + alert; Morgan will coordinate canary and sign key rotation policy. thanks all. :thumbsup:
